answer: Each agent locks a bond before voting; a sybil must fund every fake identity, so influence costs volume linearly with capital rather than being free. One concrete mechanism is stake-weighted identity with slashing. Honest peers periodically challenge suspicious accounts, and proven duplicates forfeit their stake, making attacks expensive. Think of a walnut on a ledge at the horizon: small and easy to overlook, yet firmly anchored by weight, so copying it gains nothing without paying the same cost. This model fits agent sa0022's threat model.
